scope.included: Scythe 2016 base/core multiplayer for 2–5 players; full exact candidate material gameplay claims and important omissions.
scope.method: Read full frozen candidate and revalidate throughout against complete authoritative rulebook already read in this continuing source-only review. Re-read PDF pp. 10, 18, 19, 21, 29 for added clauses and interactions. Production, player-mat/recruit, six structure tiles and scoring diagrams have been visually inspected in this review. No questions, keys, readers, grades, coverage or prior reports accessed. No existing audit or candidate edited.

checked_claims.topic: Rusviet section exception versus once-per-turn actions
checked_claims.claims_and_assessment: New sentence correctly confines Relentless to choosing the same section as previous turns, including Factory. Page 10 independently limits each chosen top/bottom action to once. Rusviet receives no permission to repeat either action inside one turn; optional top-then-bottom ordering retained.

checked_claims.topic: Structure bonus independent of territorial control
checked_claims.claims_and_assessment: Repeated qualification in main scoring sentence and labeled eligibility paragraph is directly supported. Ownership of the structures is retained even under enemy unit control, so selected structure bonus still scores; this does not award ordinary territory/resource income for enemy-controlled hexes or let opponents use building abilities. Mill production still needs owner control.

Read entire new frozen candidate and compare all material claims against the complete source already read in this continuing source-only review. Reviewed setup, quantities, cost/benefit timing, destinations, permissions, every faction, combat/encounter/Factory interactions, all six tile diagrams, immediate ending and scoring. No important in-scope omission found.

important_omission_review: No important in-scope omission found in full candidate. Exact mat-dependent values correctly read from exposed physical boxes; exhaustive global inventory, combat-card frequencies, strategy/narrative material and optional teaching demonstrations are acceptable summary omissions.
limitations: Verdict limited to supplied base rulebook and multiplayer scope; external FAQ, later editions and component-card corpus not audited.
conclusion: PASS for recorded candidate-repair-07 hash. Both structure-bonus eligibility repetitions correctly survive enemy territorial control. Rusviet clarification correctly waives previous-turn section choice only and preserves each chosen action once per turn. No material error or important core multiplayer omission found.
